skills.name: Winter Doomsday
skills.description: A Skill that deals damage in a wide area and summons an [Ice Wall] in the central 3 tiles. The [Ice Wall] can sometimes be preferentially targeted by enemies and is very powerful as a decoy or obstruction. It's useful in high-difficulty multi-enemy battles, so prioritize slotting this skill.
